author: Unknown

hero.name: Old Lady

notes: This Halloween-themed retelling follows the cumulative 'Old Lady Who Swallowed a Fly' pattern with spooky animals (bat, owl, ghost, cat, witch) swallowed in sequence. The cumulative repetitive structure makes this ideal for AAC — students can anticipate and fill in each animal. 'Swallow' is a key action verb central to every page turn. 'Scary' and 'silly' support emotional commentary on the Halloween theme. 'Night' provides setting. If the specific Lucille Colandro / Jared Lee edition is used, the character art is very distinctive and worth sourcing a matching clip art image.
